description: This file contains shell script code to configure and manage DHCP protocol within a network interface setup. It includes functions for initializing configuration, setting up DHCP, renewing leases, and tearing down the DHCP process, as well as external script sourcing and protocol registration.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_add_sendopts
methods.description: Appends DHCP send options if provided.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCP client with specified configuration parameters and starts the udhcpc process.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_renew
methods.description: Forces the DHCP lease to be renewed by sending SIGUSR1.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_teardown
methods.description: Kills the DHCP client process for the specified interface.
